profile.headline: Staff AI Software Developer at Euna Solutions

positions.title: Staff AI Software Developer
positions.description: Leading development efforts at organization-wide AI research and development team. Establishing best practices for AI agent development, model selection/fine-tuning, and third-party tool use across SDLC efficiency, AI enablement, and customer-facing AI-based feature domains.

positions.title: Software Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Technical Lead for the In Person team, which includes the Kiosk and Point of Sale products (2023 - 02/2024)
- Technical Lead for the Web team, covering the online payments product and revenue management suite (02/2024 - 2025)
positions.insights: Leading Development Teams, System Architecture and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer (fullstack, with a frontend focus) on the Web team, responsible for developing the CityBase User Profile, Web Checkout, and Revenue Management products

• Architected and built custom UI for CityBase CMS solution, working with headless GraphCMS 
  backend
• Led development of frontend for full User Profile experience (sign up and auth, management of user settings, accounts, and payments)
• Designed architecture of and developed reusable component library and multi-tenant theme 
  solution based on flat JSON and jsonnet (compile to JSON) configuration files
• Created layout primitive components to allow for construction of responsive by default layouts within the reusable component library 
• Extensive work integrating frontend with both REST and GraphQL based APIs
• Mentored junior developers on topics from language features to project and architecture 
  considerations
• Served as advisor for mid-level developer on frontend architecture of point of sale system
• Frequently collaborated with Product and UX/Design on feasibility and best practices of frontend systems and features
• Wrote proposals suggesting solutions to resolve technical debt and its implications for business stakeholders
• Occasionally worked in Elixir on backend systems, primarily on API layer

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	Leader of Frontend team, managing team of developers building applications in React/Redux
•	Web lead for development of application in React/Flux for Kindred Healthcare
•	Frontend lead for re-platform of Lotsa Helping Hands app, serving approx. 2 million annual users. Used React, Twig, HTML/CSS
•	Collaborated on design for re-platform of Lotsa Helping Hands to guide design to component based approach.
•	Developed Lotsa Helping Hands marketing pages hosted on Wordpress using Bootstrap and PHP.

positions.title: Marketing Lead
positions.description:
•	Created and maintain quarterly and weekly analytics reports
•	Developed HTML emails and landing pages
•	Conducted cluster analysis using SPSS on user activity data to group users for feedback and new feature testing
•	Head of user feedback team responsible for conducting remote feedback interviews, user experience surveys, and in-person user testing using InVision prototypes
•	Led campus representative program responsible for hiring and managing 40+ on-campus marketing representatives at law schools around the United States
•	Worked on team developing growth strategies to promote user acquisition and retention

educations.schoolName: Northwestern University Pritzker School of Law
